integration.refinement: Entire fixed grid together; sign-blind precision gate; stop at target or fixed maximum.

settings.accuracy_definition: At each positive sampled x, compare K(eps,x)-K(eps,0) with eps^2*Delta*d*x/4. All four relative discrepancies plus two numerical SE must meet the tolerance and precision target. This is accuracy of risk differences, not absolute risk or derivative accuracy.
settings.ordering_definition: Report every paired adjacent mean and SE at all five fixed orientation points. Mean >2 numerical SE and sign-blind precision are a numerical separation diagnostic, not a rigorous continuous-orbit or statistical confidence certificate.
